page.description: Dishes guests put together from parts: a pizza half and half, three scoops of their choice.

page.removeDescription: Guests will no longer build {{dish}} this way. The dish stays on your menu.

page.atBuildLimit_one: You have {{count}} build, as many as your restaurant may have. Delete it to make another.
page.atBuildLimit_other: You have {{count}} builds, as many as your restaurant may have. Delete one to make another.
